tps.bug: PasswordForm now accepts passkey-only users, but only the keycloak.v2 login-password.ftl renders the passkeys conditional UI; the base template (used by the legacy keycloak theme) does not, so a passkey-only user is shown a password-only form they cannot complete.
tps.evidenciaOpus: Only keycloak.v2/login/login-password.ftl got the passkeys import and <@passkeys.conditionalUIData/>; base/login/login-password.ftl has no passkeys UI and the legacy 'keycloak' theme (parent=base, no login-password override) uses it. With PasswordForm.configuredFor now true for passkey-only users (PasswordForm.java:63), those users get a password-only page with no way to use their passkey on the legacy/base theme.
tps.evidenciaAstra: PasswordForm.java:63 newly accepts passkey-only users, but themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/login/login-password.ftl:8-49 renders only password controls without the passkey macro. The legacy keycloak/login/theme.properties:1 inherits base, whereas the required macro invocation was added only to keycloak.v2/login/login-password.ftl:18, leaving the legacy password challenge unusable for these users.
